scope: Exactly 82 final-paper historical checkpoint evaluations, not training or exploratory experiments.
data_root_semantics: Root corresponding to /123090274/SN_Research; bundle keeps relative_to_remote_root paths.
notes: Generation batch sizes are historical per-invocation values, not a global convenience default.
CLERC uses the later common FP16 protocol; locked500 policy runs use BF16.
seed records the evaluation config RNG seed. Native no-recovery uses 20260817; guard-only uses the 20260829 evaluation prompt/config with the same pre-recovery adapter.
Do not reorder stored source_tokens, parent rows, or frontend events.
Running each TransLLaMA k separately preserves per-k evaluation batch construction; model loading time is not paper latency.
Speech checkpoint entries use recorded frontend events; full audio/frontend regeneration is a separate pipeline.
Historical environment recordings are not proof of clean installation or bitwise numerical reproducibility.
